summary: Fitness Champs Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) posting results of an extraordinary general meeting held June 29, 2026. Shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital—from US$500,000 to US$23,000,000—by creating additional Class A ordinary shares, and authorized a discretionary reverse share split of between 2:1 and 500:1. The filing is a routine meeting outcome report with no special situation transaction. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change.
